stories.title: 4th quarter explosion ends Utah Jazz losing streak in Los Angeles
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz flipped the script with a massive fourth quarter that fueled that team's second win of the season in Los Angeles on Tuesday.

stories.title: Season's first major snowfall turns Wasatch into winter playground
stories.summary: The season's first major mountain storm is bringing winter to Utah's high country, blanketing the Wasatch with snow and drawing eager skiers and snowboarders alike.

stories.title: Salt Lake City passes 6-month pause on data centers, seeks future adjustments
stories.summary: The City Council voted Tuesday to impose a 180-day pause on data centers in the city, sparked by a proposal on the west side.

stories.title: BYU, Utah remain locked in place in latest College Football Playoff rankings
stories.summary: With two games left in the regular season — two games Utah is favored to win — Utah is a near lock for a College Football Playoff berth in Morgan Scalley's first season as a head coach.

stories.title: Chicago man sentenced to 10 years for trafficking drugs through Utah
stories.summary: A Chicago man who was caught with 25 pounds of cocaine in his car while driving through Utah was handed a 10-year prison sentence on Friday.

stories.title: Ohio man who sexually abused Utah minor given 45 years in prison
stories.summary: An Ohio man who was arrested in Utah for sexually abusing a Utah minor was sentenced Tuesday to 45 years in prison.

stories.title: Apple joins a parade of technology hiccups in recent days
stories.summary: A pair of technology failures at Apple and Marriott International follows several other recent major outages, highlighting the risks of relying on just a few major providers of essential technology.

stories.title: UHP targets 'left-lane loafers,' and the drivers who act aggressively toward them
stories.summary: The Utah Highway Patrol recently conducted an enforcement blitz, targeting drivers who impede traffic flow in the left lane, as well as drivers who act aggressively toward them.

stories.title: Intermountain Health breaks ground on new LDS Hospital in downtown Salt Lake City
stories.summary: Intermountain Health officially broke ground Tuesday on a new LDS Hospital at the former Sears property near 800 South and State Street in downtown Salt Lake City.

stories.title: Millburn defeats Lee in Davis County Commission race; Lee backer calls for probe
stories.summary: Bret Millburn defeated Susan Lee in a close Davis County Commission race, but Lee campaign manager, Jason Sanders, is calling for a probe into the contest.

stories.title: Federal review faults leadership failures in Grand Canyon fire that destroyed lodge
stories.summary: Leadership failures along with a lack of preparedness and poor communication were the driving factors behind a wildfire that destroyed a historic lodge and dozens of structures along the North Rim of Grand Canyon National Park.

stories.title: Former southern Utah lawmaker, business figure Dixie Leavitt dies at 97
stories.summary: State and Southern Utah University leaders remembered the Cedar City business icon and father of former Gov. Mike Leavitt as a "giant" whose legacy of public service will last for generations.
